title: Positive integral reduction of bounded constructible complexes
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l with continuous condensed integer ring O_E, and a Noetherian scheme X. Use finite constant-model constructibility [sk-def-sfb-constructible] and the actual derived quotient extension [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. If K is a bounded integral complex with finite constant-model constructible cohomology, then for every n≥0 its derived reduction along O_E→O_E/(pi_E^(n+1)) is bounded with finite constant-model constructible cohomology over the quotient. No completeness, torsion-freeness, characteristic, or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed. This includes n=0, zero complexes, and empty schemes.

proof.text: For a constructible sheaf in degree zero, use the finite scalar-model quotient theorem. Its scalar matrix calculation gives bounded constructible cohomology over the actual positive quotient, including torsion scalar models.

Identify quotient constant-model constructibility with fixed finite-module constructible cohomology by the normalized encoding. The fixed-module bounded constructible origin theorem identifies this with the triangulated etale-origin property. Exact homology comparison gives both directions.

Take the inverse image of this triangulated property under derived coefficient reduction followed by the fixed-module derived encoding. Bounded truncation devissage reduces membership to the degree-zero sheaf case, then transfer the result back to the quotient constant-model predicate.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1), finite reductions; constructibility is the finite-truncation extension of the scalar-model calculation; Z7 makes this substep explicit without changing the unit route. The positive-reduction theorem is proved; it introduces no hole.

lean.statement:
theorem integralReduction_constantModelBoundedConstructible
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X))
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X K)
    (n : ℕ) :
    constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E (n + 1)) X
      ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X n).obj K)
